description:
Court notebook. This page contains a record of divorce and a trousseau list from Cairo in the 1180s. The mother of the bride gave the couple half a house on the condition that she would receive rent during the first year. Each of the two columns was written by a different scribe and is a separate record. 

I (recto, right column): A woman gives her daughter 1/2 a house on the occasion of her marriage. She promises to register it with an Islamic notary and stipulates that she should receive the rent for the first year. Signed by Yehuda b. Moshe ha-Mumḥe and Yosef b. Hillel. 

II (recto, left column and verso): Dowry evaluation (taqwīm) for [...] b. Yeḥezqel ha-Kohen and the orphan Sitt al-Maʿālī bt. Yeshuʿa b. Peraḥya. Dowry: 55 dinars. Marriage payments: 5 + 25 = 30. The bride receives half a house in partnership with her infant brother Bū Manṣūr. Her mother is Sitt al-Fakhr. Lines 1-5 written by Shelomo b. Zakkai. 

(Information from Goitein's index card and from Amir Ashur's dissertation)
description_he: פנקס בית דין. I: אישה נותנת לבתה מחצית בית לרגל נישואיה, חתמו: יהודה ב. משה המומחה ויוסף ב. הלל. II: הערכת נדוניה עבור [...] ב. יחזקל הכהן ויתומה סת אל-מעאלי בת ישועה ב. פרחיה. נדוניה: 55. תשלומי נישואין: 5 + 25 = 30
